name: iNK — indie northern kentucky
limitations: Official store information and the 2026 bookstore-crawl organizer’s guide; no on-site audit. The crawl guide reports a single entrance step but gives no alternative route. Current step-free entry, door operation, aisle widths, stage access, toilets and changing facilities remain unverified. Crawl hours are event-specific and are not used as regular opening hours. The store is now in Dayton; older Bellevue accounts describe a different location.
facts: The shop directs visitors to street parking in front and across the street, excluding the green-curb space. It also identifies a public lot across from the fire station, beyond Tuba Baking Co.; designated spaces and the complete route are unverified.
street parking in front of the store + across the street (do not park in the space along the street with the green curb)
public lot parking down the road across from the fire station - on the other side of tuba baking co.
The 2026 Cincy Bookstore Crawl guide describes one step into the older building. It gives no alternative entrance or ramp arrangement; confirm current entry options before travel.
Public parking lots. Older building with one step up to get into the store.
Regular hours are Thursday–Friday 2–6 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday through Wednesday are listed as closed. In-store special events can have different hours.
hours will differ for in-store special events
The creator space has drawing tables and art supplies, plus a stage, sound system and projector for events. The shop does not describe stage access, captioning or quieter sessions.
the creator space is set up with drawing tables and stocked with art supplies
with a stage, sound system, and projector for visual elements
